Package com.lemarketjames.market.entity

Class InstrumentMarketParamsEntity

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.market.entity.InstrumentMarketParamsEntity
@Entity public class InstrumentMarketParamsEntity extends Object
Simulation settings for one instrument (instrument_market_params, migration 006).

Linked to instruments by a plain id rather than a JPA relationship so the market feature does not depend on the orders feature's Instrument entity.
